summary: Added sdk/actions (catalog.py, __init__.py): ActionSpec records naming the Client method, mutating flag, idempotency class, required params, preconditions and postcondition for collect_all_resources, collect_daily_reward, add_training, upgrade_room and add_research. check_preconditions returns blocking reasons. reconcile() uses diff_snapshots and returns VERIFIED, NOT_OBSERVED, CONTRADICTED or UNKNOWN from observed state only; response_ok is recorded but never yields VERIFIED. Added 12 tests covering every outcome per action, HTTP-success-alone, cross-account refusal, and parity with the capability inventory. Added docs/baseline/action-catalog.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Mutating Client methods report success from HTTP responses or not at all
contract_status_changes.after: Catalogued actions carry declared preconditions and observed-state postconditions with explicit unknown and contradicted outcomes

residual_risks: Client.upgradeRooms upgrades all eligible rooms and takes no room id; the upgrade_room spec reconciles one room, so the runner must reconcile every room touched or add a targeted call.
add_training is always UNKNOWN until AccountSnapshot observes training state.
Concurrent spending on the same account would make collections look CONTRADICTED.
